title: Zoe 2
description:
@@The Sampler
Zoe uses 10 (.wav, mp3) file sample slots to build 10 drum components drum-kits. According to this approach, every slot can be anything, from kicks to snares or cymbals or you name it. Each slot is triggered by its own unique midi note which noted on its slot button. For instance, slot 48 is triggered by note number 48 in the midi keyboard (c2). The samples menu is divided into 14 categories, including a wide range of drum-kit components types. Once you press on any type button, you get the list of the samples you can choose from. Zoe comes with 30 full built-in drum-kits.

@@The Morph System
Zoe is armed with brand new morphing system which can blend any 2 drum elements together (which can create tons of new fresh drum sounds). The morph system can also play with the blended element's pitch and increase the invention of new drum sounds like never before.

@@The Mixer
Zoe has a built-in mixer that allows you to tweak any sample separately. You can use the EQ, change the pitch, add a random pitch manipulation to every sample, pan and or add saturation, phase effect, delay or some interesting coloring by using our Zelda filer.

@@The Kit Manager
Zoe loads drumkits extremely fast, only 0.6 sec for full loading. It can set "sample start and "sample end" points with midi assignable knobs and it also allows you to tweak the active keyboard's octaves starting points and tweak or fire up the master effects by using macro knobs and buttons. Zoe uses 24 presets drumkit banks. Each preset represents a full drum-kit containing all the components and settings.

@@The Arpeggiator
Zoe is not only a great sampler but also an arranger styles midi sequencer. It uses the arranger keyboards style sequencer method to run 8 simultaneous midi grooves per style that can be switched instantly with a midi keyboard. Each variation gets its own midi key number and the transitions are synced to the determined tempo. Zoe can also add an automatic cymbal crash on end points and use self or synced tempo. The midi sequence can be also sent out to the DAW through the midi channels and trigger other VSTi's.

@@Special Channel's Modulation Effects
Each channel in Zoe is armed with dedicated modulation effects which allow adding beautiful nuances and textures to each drum element separately. There is a yowling phaser effect, a delay and the new Zelda filter which can completely change the audio materials native character and morph it into a new interesting sound

@@GUI And Controls
Zoe has a customizable GUI which can be set by the user. You can change the GUI scale and switch controls color on the fly.

@@Full features list
#10 drum sample slots per kit
#10 virtual drum-pads
#14 drum element banks with full 30 drum-kits that adjusted to wide range of pop and EDM genres
#Drum elements morphing system per element
#Automation file manager
#4 additional wav. pages in the element menu for user's wav. files
#Midi assignable start/end points manager
#Master effect macro knobs
#Graphical midi keyboard with assignable keyboard starting points
#Full virtual mixer with gain knobs, master effect send knobs, pitch knobs, random pitch manager knobs, round robin and pan knobs, #master compressor, delay and reverb effects armed with a unique F.R. feature.
#64 steps arranger style arpeggiator with 8 variations per style, unique time signature per variation, midi keyboard controllable #variation switch, crash every selected end point, cymbal crash manager, unique or synced tempo
#Midi route options (internal or sent to the DAW through midi channels)
#Stereo or 10 separate outputs to the DAW (1 per drum element)
#Scalable and customizable GUI
